_comment: Episodes of the Brief's own show, newest first. scripts/build_podcast.py REWRITES this file when SPOTIFY_CLIENT_ID / SPOTIFY_CLIENT_SECRET are set — set those (free app at developer.spotify.com/dashboard) and every episode appears automatically. Until then this is hand-maintained: add {id, title, url, date, blurb} and it shows up (id is the /episode/<id> part of the Spotify link — the tab needs it to build the episode embed). Dates are the release dates off each episode's own Spotify page.

episodes.title: It Was Meant To Be: DJ Cheetatah
There Was Always a Vision: Heloise Williams Returns
episodes.blurb: Heloise Williams — Burlington frontwoman of Heloise & The Savoir Faire, signed to Elijah Wood's Simian Records and backed on record by Debbie Harry — has spent the years since Diamond Dust practicing as a therapist. Now she's stepping back into the spotlight. Start with "Odyle" and "Illusions", then come back ready.

episodes.title: DJ Fattie B Spins Up New Board Game "Drop The Needle" Inspired by Podcast Success
episodes.blurb: From podcast to playroom: DJ Fattie B is bringing his hit show 3some to life with Drop The Needle, a board game about the songs that shaped our musical souls — designed with nostalgic vinyl aesthetics at his Vergennes home, launching in Vermont shops before going national with a little help from Questlove.
